title: Improve ROM inventory opening readability
changes: Separate merged words, numbers and addresses in the inventory introduction and BG graphics, terrain and UI choice-list summaries while retaining recorded evidence and limits.
validation: Compared the entire edited inventory with its pre-edit version for identical digit runs, Markdown link targets and inline code spans; checked the 320-frame Party and palette byte counts against the linked evidence guides.
limitations: Only the opening and first three migration-matrix entries were reviewed for readability; the rest of this large inventory and the wider English-first audit remain pending. Historical runtime results were not reproduced.
